03 — GOOD TO KNOW

A little clarity.

Where can I get PriorityDesk?+

PriorityDesk for Windows is now live on Microsoft Store. Visit the download section to get it. The Android companion is coming soon to Google Play.

Can I use it offline?+

Yes. Task and project data are saved locally, so you can keep working without an internet connection. On Windows, you can choose your data folder in the app’s Options.

Do I need an account?+

No account is needed for local use. Sign in with a personal, work or school Microsoft account only if you want optional OneDrive sync. Work and school accounts may need approval from your organisation’s IT administrator.

Can I sync across devices?+

Optional OneDrive sync keeps tasks, projects and attached files in step across your Windows PCs. The Android companion also supports OneDrive sync and is currently progressing through Google Play testing ahead of its public release.

When will Android be available?+

PriorityDesk for Android is coming soon to Google Play. Testing is in progress, and the public release date has not yet been announced. This page will be updated with a download link when it is available.
